purpose: Compact registry of architecture and workflow decisions made for the workbench.

decisions.title: Retrieval router uses RAG setup gate
decisions.summary: Use grep/index as the default and source-code retrieval strategy. Add retrieval routing and project scope now. Keep RAG as an explicit setup gate for AI/workbench memory only, not source code.

decisions.title: Feedback audit workflow scope
decisions.summary: Implement Unity MCP support, feedback memory, decision logs, bootstrap snapshots, package-lock Unity context, Unity verification scripts, project summaries, performance budgets, and manual handoff notes; keep session documentation and handoffs explicit rather than automatic.
